run_image_client: run the image client script to stream camera images via TCP to a remote server
run_send_png: run send_png.py to encode and transmit color and depth camera frames at 15 Hz
review_ImageClient: review the ImageClient class that sends compressed color and depth images to a TCP server
refactor_ImageClient_spin: refactor the ImageClient spin method to support configurable frame rates and server addresses
test_ImageClient_encoding: test the ImageClient encode_color and encode_depth methods for correct WebP and PNG output
